document.abstract: A simple principle of a simultaneous recording of both streak and framing record of the same event makes possible direct separate frame observation during streak recording of high-speed events. The system permits progressive, full-frame identification from the same observation point of phenomena often difficult to identify with certainty on a streak record alone.
